laneScans.status: expanded primary-source sample; mixed release stages
laneScans.zh: 官方线从原六项扩到产品发布、操作文档和固定代码。实际复读 Mintlify 的 Autopilot、credits 与 GitHub 前提，Exa 的 Lite 参数及缓存限制，BILL 的风险检查与控制中心，Motive 的触发动作与未来外呼时间表；工作场景再追 Harmony、Lens、Payani、Demandbase、Google 政府服务和 Cloudflare。Different 原始新闻稿明确十月二十日十点 UTC，早于截止；Demandbase 在十四点，仍在窗口。Mintlify 和政府版 Gemini 只有当天日期，保留待核时观察，不补造时分。当前文档也可能晚于原截止更新，不能倒推历史功能或套餐。TorchNeuron 已补成独立迁移分析，不再沿用早稿因主题重复而只列观察的决定。这是有界且非穷尽的原始来源样本：公告、Beta、私有预览、计划开放与已交付分别记录，未进入客户账户验证。
laneScans.en: The official-source pass now extends the original six stories with product announcements, operational documentation and pinned code. Actual reads include Mintlify Autopilot setup and credits, Exa Lite parameters and cached retrieval, BILL risk checks and centralized controls, and Motive trigger/action workflows versus its later voice-agent roadmap. Additional workplace dossiers follow Harmony, Lens, Payani, Demandbase, government Gemini and Cloudflare. Different’s original release establishes 10:00 UTC on October 20; Demandbase is recorded at 14:00, still before the 14:08 cutoff. Mintlify and government Gemini have only same-day dates and remain timing-unverified observations. Current documentation is not a historical snapshot of features or entitlements. TorchNeuron now has a distinct migration dossier, superseding the earlier decision to retain it only because its topic overlapped. This is a bounded, non-exhaustive primary-source sample. Announcements, beta access, private preview, planned availability and delivered capability remain separate states, and no customer account was used to verify service behavior.

laneScans.status: partial independent-review access; no reproduced product benchmark
laneScans.zh: 评测线实际发现 Reuters、TechCrunch 的 TorchNeuron 报道及 VentureBeat 的芯片报道，主要用于核对公告，不充当独立能耗测试。StorageReview 的 Open WebUI Desktop 页面提取曾只返回导航及同意面板，不能从标题推断速度结果。扩刊读取 Krea 的价格与速度口径、Coralboard 的厂商比较、Dream-1 的研究 Beta 和 Own 1 的厂家跑分说法，但这些仍属于厂商或作者证据；未把新闻转述、客户证言和自己的产品推断叠加成独立复现。已有云端页面与图片验收只验证本刊产物、图像内容及来源，不等于测试被报道产品。公开截图也可能是样例、预览或未来界面：Mintlify 装饰插图与 Motive 未来目标框已被识别，不可作当前操作证明。本线有界、非穷尽，仍缺同版本、同负载、包含失败恢复与完整费用的合法可读独立对照，不能报“评测通过”。
laneScans.en: The review lane found Reuters and TechCrunch coverage of TorchNeuron and VentureBeat coverage of the chip announcements, principally as corroboration of an announcement rather than independent energy tests. The StorageReview Open WebUI Desktop extraction previously returned navigation and consent controls instead of the review body; its title cannot establish a speed result. Expansion added Krea’s price and latency claims, Coralboard’s vendor comparison, Dream-1’s research beta and Own 1’s maker-described benchmarks. These remain vendor or author evidence. News repetition, selected customer testimony and editorial interpretation are not independent reproductions when combined. Cloud browser checks of this publication and pixel inspection of its illustrations validate the publication artifact, not the products being reported. Images can also depict samples or future capabilities: Mintlify’s decorative illustration and Motive’s future goal-entry screen must not demonstrate current workflows. This bounded, non-exhaustive lane still lacks matched-version independent comparisons covering workload, failures, recovery and full cost; no product is described as having passed our benchmark.

laneScans.status: public issues, maker comments and forum samples; private channels not read
laneScans.zh: 社区线完整读取 Hermes 问题及唯一回复，再用官方 README 和发行记录核对：十月十九日十点零一 UTC 的报告属于近三日补充，单个报告者及非维护者回复不能证明普遍故障率。扩刊还读到 Figma Specs 十月十六日用户希望集中目录和悬浮预览的帖子，论坛标记 Solved 只伴随转交团队，不能写成已实现。Product Hunt 的 Beam 和 walkai-talkai 作者评论用于追查重连、音频回传和已知限制；点赞、赞美、作者承诺不等于独立验收。Open Robotics 的 robot-data-diff 作者介绍与 PyPI 首发、固定提交分开记。GitHub 曾遇限流，未据此声称平台不可用。未进入私密 Discord、微信社群或登录后的 X，也没有全量采样 Reddit；公开评论仅为有界非穷尽线索，缺少总体分母、版本对照与后续验证。
laneScans.en: The community lane read the Hermes issue and its single reply, then checked official documentation and release context. The October 19 report at 10:01 UTC is a three-day supplement; one reporter and a non-maintainer reply cannot establish a population failure rate. Expansion also read the October 16 Figma Specs request for centralized navigation and a floating preview. Its Solved label accompanies a support handoff, not evidence that those features shipped. Beam and walkai-talkai maker comments on Product Hunt explain reconnection, radio replies and limitations, but votes, praise and maker assurances are not independent acceptance tests. The robot-data-diff introduction on Open Robotics is dated separately from its PyPI release and pinned commit. A prior GitHub rate-limit encounter is recorded as a request-level gap, not platform unavailability. Private Discord, WeChat groups and login-only X were not entered, and Reddit was not comprehensively sampled. These are bounded public observations without a population denominator, matched-version comparison or confirmed follow-up.

laneScans.status: expanded Product Hunt, startup and maker sample; mixed maturity
laneScans.zh: 探索线实际扫描 Product Hunt 十月十九日可见精选十七项、十月十七日精选和第四十二周榜，再跟到 Beam、walkai-talkai、Own 1 等作者页面。父线程的并行公开扫描成功访问十月二十日榜，补得 bonds、ToDo.is、Jotform 等线索；早先单次失败不能写成该日普遍不可访问。榜单是发现入口，不是首发时间：Figma Specs 追到十五日，Composio Instant 为八日，RunInfra 更早。Hackaday、Hackster、Open Robotics 与仓库补出 Pythia、南瓜、手机 Harness 和数据比较工具；Different 则追到原始发布稿及产品审阅链。Pythia 可写原型，不能称有可复刻源码；Own 1 可写预生产提案，不能称已经交货。本线有界非穷尽，未遍历榜单全部分页、众筹平台或所有仓库；缺完整接口、图证或日期者保留明确原因，不为条数上限删掉已具实质内容的产品。
laneScans.en: The exploratory pass read seventeen visible featured cards from the October 19 Product Hunt archive, the October 17 archive and week 42, then followed maker pages including Beam, walkai-talkai and Own 1. A parallel public scan by the parent also accessed October 20 and surfaced bonds, ToDo.is and Jotform; an earlier individual failure must not become a claim that the day was universally inaccessible. Rankings are discovery surfaces, not first-release evidence: Figma Specs traces to October 15, Composio Instant to October 8, and RunInfra earlier still. Hackaday, Hackster, Open Robotics and repositories added Pythia, the pumpkin, phone Harness and dataset comparison work. Different was followed to its original release and approval workflow. Pythia supports a prototype observation, not a reproducible open-source claim; Own 1 supports a preproduction proposal, not confirmed shipment. This bounded, non-exhaustive scan did not traverse every archive page, crowdfunding platform or repository. Missing interfaces, imagery or dates remain explicit gaps rather than reasons to enforce an arbitrary story quota.

laneScans.status: expanded full-paper and version sample; no experiment replication
laneScans.zh: 研究线由 VISAGENT 扩到 Promptile、OpenVLHarness、Cling、ConverseMR、GazeAgent、SplatXR 与 InteractAgent 的原始论文及可访问项目资料。Promptile 和 OpenVLHarness 的十九日下午提交位于主窗口；Cling、SplatXR、InteractAgent 在近三日，十七日上午的两项 XR 研究已超过七十二小时。核对结果保留了有意义的限制：Promptile 少打字却未更快，Cling 使用归档网页和预缓存结构，GazeAgent 仍是离线推理，SplatXR 代码链接返回404，InteractAgent 仓库与论文骨干不一致。原论文图只证明研究设计与作者结果，不代表商用品或独立复现。Annotrace 版本变化未建立实质差分，TapID 的旧会议时间也阻止把新索引当新研究。扫描有界非穷尽，未遍历 ACM、所有实验室或完整 arXiv 列表，未运行模型或实验；评估对象、样本量、配置与许可分别留在各稿。
laneScans.en: The research lane expanded from VISAGENT to original papers and accessible project material for Promptile, OpenVLHarness, Cling, ConverseMR, GazeAgent, SplatXR and InteractAgent. Promptile and OpenVLHarness have afternoon October 19 submissions within the main window. Cling, SplatXR and InteractAgent belong to the nearby-days supplement, while the October 17 morning XR submissions are already beyond seventy-two hours. The review preserves substantive limits: Promptile reduced typing without reducing time; Cling used archived pages and cached structure; GazeAgent inference is offline; SplatXR’s code link returned 404; and InteractAgent’s repository backbone differs from the paper. Original figures document research design and author-reported results, not a commercial release or independent replication. Annotrace’s version update lacked an established substantive difference, and TapID’s older conference date prevents treating a fresh index entry as new research. This was a bounded, non-exhaustive paper sample, not a census of ACM, laboratories or arXiv. No models or experiments were run; evaluation scope, configurations and licensing remain item-specific.

laneScans.status: public discovery attempted; no qualified current publication; provider gap
laneScans.zh: 专利线确实执行了带日期、智能眼镜、人工智能与用户界面的公开查询，并检查命中字段。Twilio 的动态上下文窗口 WO2025221751A1 与 Samsung 的可穿戴外壳 WO2025220987A1 实际公开于二〇二五年十月二十三日，命中的二〇二六年十月十五日来自预计失效字段，均不能算本周。另有 Samsung US20260319572A1 与 McCreary US20260321263A1 的十五日二手线索，但原始公开、权利要求和同族未取齐，仍不提升为已核实专利。现有专利连接器只读状态显示没有配置数据提供方，Google Patents 原生日期筛选页也读取失败；没有为此创建凭据或改变配置。本线是有界非穷尽的检索和排除记录，不等于全球没有相关专利。USPTO、WIPO、EPO、CNIPA 的完整原生检索与同族归并尚未完成，不能以专利标题推断量产计划，也没有可计入本刊的当期原始专利图。
laneScans.en: Patent work included actual public queries combining dates with smart glasses, artificial intelligence and user interfaces, followed by inspection of the matched metadata. Twilio’s dynamic-context-window record WO2025221751A1 and Samsung’s wearable-housing record WO2025220987A1 were published on October 23, 2025. Their matched October 15, 2026 field concerned anticipated expiry, so neither is current-week evidence. Later discovery included secondary October 15 leads for Samsung US20260319572A1 and McCreary US20260321263A1, but original publications, claims and family relationships remain unverified. Read-only connector status showed no configured patent providers, and the filtered Google Patents results page was inaccessible. No credentials were created or configuration changed. This is a bounded, non-exhaustive search-and-exclusion record, not a statement that no relevant patent exists worldwide. Comprehensive native USPTO, WIPO, EPO and CNIPA searching and family reconciliation were not completed. A patent title cannot establish manufacturing plans, and no verified current-window original patent figure is available for the edition.

laneScans.status: Chinese-language and China-linked primary sample; regional/private gaps
laneScans.zh: 中国相关线先读镜舟 MIP 官方产品、语义文章和发布材料，明确预约演示与文档待上线，不把会议发布当全量自助开放。扩刊继续核对 Unitree UniUni 官方控制入口、AiMOGA Mobo 的原始预告，以及 DeepSeek DeepInfer 截止前固定代码和部署问答。UniUni 来源仍要区分官方演示与十九日二手报道，Mobo 十七日预告的二十一日揭幕尚未发生，DeepInfer 固定提交不是正式发行标签。此前发现的 ManageEngine 中国消息与更早全球发布不合并算新能力；STEPX Neo 仍只有二手首销线索。中国专利原件与微信私密直播、登录 demo、社群讨论没有补齐，不宣称已全面覆盖国内生态。这里是有界非穷尽地域取样：英文发布的中国厂商也在内，中文转载不自动获得独立证据资格。采购地区、许可、实际售价与账户开放仍需逐项核实，不能由全球营销页推断加拿大或中国均可用。
laneScans.en: The China-related lane first read MirrorShip’s official MIP product, semantic explanations and launch material, preserving the distinction between a demo request, forthcoming documentation and universal self-service access. Expansion checked the official Unitree UniUni control entry, AiMOGA Mobo’s original announcement and DeepSeek DeepInfer code and deployment questions pinned before the cutoff. UniUni’s official demonstration is distinguished from October 19 secondary coverage. Mobo’s October 17 announcement schedules an October 21 unveiling that had not occurred. A DeepInfer commit is not a formal tagged release. The earlier ManageEngine China lead is not counted again as a new global capability, and STEPX Neo remains a secondary first-sale lead. Chinese patent originals, private WeChat streams, login-gated demonstrations and closed communities remain gaps. This bounded, non-exhaustive regional sample includes Chinese vendors publishing in English; Chinese-language repetition does not become independent evidence. Procurement region, licensing, actual price and account entitlement require item-specific verification, rather than assuming that a global marketing page proves availability in China or Canada.

laneScans.status: cross-region availability and stage checks; no country-by-country census
laneScans.zh: 全球线重点核查同一产品在地区和交付阶段上的差别，而不是把一条厂商稿重复计作多国独立证据。SpeakON 的美国可用性不推出加拿大交付，Bee Frontier 美国销售与 Eclipse 即将推出分开，Surface 的十六日计划可用节点不等于已核实各地库存。Brera 由馆方与 Meta 原始材料交叉说明是八幅作品的无障碍试点，不是所有博物馆覆盖；NEURA 展示日程与桌面研究 Beta 也不写成已普及机器人。软件侧保留 Mintlify Beta、Lens Beta、Google 政府私有预览和 Clairic 托管预览等阶段，当前价目与旧稿冲突不静默覆盖。所有日期仍对原十四点零八 UTC 截止，之后采集只补证据，EarthCam 和 OneDrive 明确晚于截止的事件不纳入新增。本线有界非穷尽，未做各国账号、商店、采购和物流实测；地域、费用、授权与发布时刻未知的地方继续写未知。
laneScans.en: The global lane checks regional and delivery-stage differences rather than counting one company statement as independent evidence from several countries. SpeakON’s US availability does not establish Canadian delivery. Bee Frontier’s US sales are separate from Eclipse’s forthcoming status, and Surface’s planned October 16 availability does not verify local stock. Brera’s museum and Meta sources describe an accessibility pilot around eight works, not coverage of every museum. NEURA demonstration dates and a desktop robotics research beta are likewise not broad deployment evidence. Software stages remain explicit: Mintlify beta, Lens beta, government Gemini private preview and Clairic hosted preview are different commitments. Current pricing or documentation conflicts are not silently projected backward. Every event still faces the original 14:08 UTC cutoff; later collection adds evidence rather than extending the news window. EarthCam and OneDrive events known to occur afterward remain excluded. This is a bounded, non-exhaustive regional check without country-by-country account, storefront, procurement or shipping tests; unknown region, fee, entitlement and publication time remain unknown.
